targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_http_req_duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "95_percentile")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.status != "0" and int(v: r.status) < 500)
  |> group()
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_http_req_duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "95_percentile")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.status != "0" and int(v: r.status) < 500)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name !~ /\.(js|css|png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|woff2?|ico|webp)(\?.*)?$/)
  |> group()
  |> mean()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_data_received")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_data_sent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_http_req_duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mean")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.status == "200")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "k6_vus")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "k6_http_reqs")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: float(v: r._value) / float(v: uint(v: v.windowPeriod) / uint(v: 1000000000))
  }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "k6_http_req_failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_http_req_duration" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error"])
  |> sum()
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "count"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_http_req_duration" and r._field == "95_percentile")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error"])
  |> max()
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "95_percentile"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k6_http_req_duration" and r._field == "mean")
  |> group(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error"])
  |> mean()
  |> keep(columns: ["name", "method", "status", "error", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with isError: r.status == "0" }))
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "mean"})
  |> group()

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
      r.testid == "${testid}" and 
      r.scenario =~ /${scenario:regex}/ and
      r.group =~ /${group:regex}/ and
      r.location =~ /${location:regex}/ 
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "${measurement}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mean" or r._field == "upper" or r._field == "lower" or r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

targets.expr: tags.testid:${testid} AND tags.location:(${location}) | sort by (_time, _stream_id, fields.seq)
